proposal.summary: SQL injection in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information by supplying a crafted string that bypasses a blacklist function.
proposal.cwe_quote: SQL injection vulnerability in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.

AC.quote: via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Reproduce the issue against DataEase v1.18.9, identify the vulnerable SQL query and input vector that bypasses the blacklist, and prepare a patch that uses parameterized queries or proper input validation/whitelisting. If confirmed, coordinate disclosure and provide users with upgrade and mitigation guidance.

evidence_quotes.quote: SQL injection vulnerability in DataEase v.1.18.9 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via a crafted string outside of the blacklist function.

evidence_quotes.claim: Indicates remote attacker (no local/physical access required)
